tldr: Black Moon Lilith in the 6th house.
body: You refuse to be a compliant worker or to ignore your body; raw instinct around labor and health. Resists being managed and is drawn to unconventional or independent work; clashes with bosses are common. Health here can mirror deeper emotional pressure, so treat the whole person, not just symptoms.
business: Sets fierce boundaries at work and actually listens to the body.
shadow: Defiant burnout, or repression that surfaces as illness.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
